run.executedVia: Playwright driving Lightning Experience. Every screen assertion is cross-checked against the ServiceNow record over cnit and the Salesforce record over the sf CLI. No case in this file writes to either platform.

case.title: Sync Health strip sits above the grid

steps.text: Open the CAF Dashboard tab and let it settle.
Read the strip, and measure where it sits relative to the grid.

observations: It ran on load without Re-check being pressed — the headline had resolved from "Checking ServiceNow…" to a verdict by the time the grid was readable.
expected: It runs on load, without being asked.
Its state is legible at a glance, and visible without scrolling.
actual: Strip reads "In sync" (green) — 297 records verified · 109 requests · 182 tasks · 6 controls
Strip top 255px, grid top 347px; strip is above the grid: true
case.verdictReason: Strip renders above the grid at 255px, in the first viewport, already resolved to "In sync".
